description: This file handles media processing in a web/media context, including loading, optimizing, and converting images, as well as managing local and remote media sources with security considerations.

classes.name: WebMediaResult
classes.description: Type representing the result of loading media, including buffer, content type, media kind, and filename.

methods.name: resolveWebMediaOptions
methods.description: Resolves and normalizes options for web media processing, handling maxBytes and optimization flags.

methods.name: loadWebMedia
methods.description: Loads media from a URL with default image optimization.

methods.name: loadWebMediaRaw
methods.description: Loads media from a URL without image optimization.

methods.name: optimizeImageToJpeg
methods.description: Converts and resizes images to JPEG format within size constraints, including HEIC support.
